info.name: Hide Useless Google Docs/Slides/Sheets Icons
info.description:
Hide buttons you generally don't need, like undo/redo/zoom. The space that's freed up this way allows the ui to show more buttons, specially in narrow screens.

List of hidden buttons:

#newSlideButton, #newSlideMenuButton,#redoButton,#undoButton,#printButton,#paintFormatButton,#zoomButton,#selectButton, #insertLinkButton,#insertCommentButton, #commentSeparator, #indentButton, #outdentButton
